import numpy as np
def equation(eps, T, params):
    L = np.log(eps)
    p = params
    G = np.exp(p[9]*T)
    one = np.ones_like(eps)
    return (p[0] + p[1]*L + p[2]*eps + p[3]/eps + p[4]*np.sqrt(eps)
            + p[5]*G + p[6]*G*L + p[7]*G/eps + p[8]*T*eps + p[9]*0)
